lines.text: The LORD sent prophets, but the people would not listen, and then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah.
By the king's order, Zechariah was stoned at the LORD's house, and he asked the LORD to forgive Joash.

wrong_details.true: see this and call Joash to account

lines.text: Joash's own servants killed him on his bed, and his son Amaziah reigned in his place.
